report.summary: All tagged claims check out against the cited DRHP pages apart from one soft inference: p29 supports the absence of any explicit OFS/selling-shareholder disclosure, but the report's 'every clue points to a fresh issue' clause is not stated on that page and should be softened or re-sourced. No unsupported, wrong-source, or untagged specific claims were identified; the financial figures, percentages, names and dates all match the cited excerpts after lakh-to-crore conversion.
